about: Victoria is the capital of British Columbia, on the southern tip of Vancouver Island at the Inner Harbour. The city proper is compact: the legislature, downtown, and older neighbourhoods sit around the harbour, while most of Greater Victoria lies in adjoining municipalities such as Saanich. Ferries, floatplanes, and a mild coastal climate underpin government, tourism, and retirement life. About 92,000 people live in the City of Victoria.
seoSummary: British Columbia’s capital, a compact Inner Harbour city at the south end of Vancouver Island.
